title: Extraction of PCB18 and Its Hydroxylated Metabolites from Animal Tissues
author: Xueshu Li
materials: Cap tube-A and the Reference standard.
Invert tube-B for 5 minutes, then centrifuge.
Cap all vials immediately with a crimp cap.

Dispose of the following materials as indicated: Scalpel – sharps container. Homogenizer probe – dispose as PCB-contaminated hazardous waste. SPE cartridges – Remove the cartridges from the SPE manifold and dispose the content as PCB-contaminated hazardous waste. Place the cartridges in the sink to be washed. Evaporator – Place needles in a glass beaker and combust in the furnace. Tube-A, Tube-B, Tube-C, Tube-D, and other aqueous solutions – dispose as aqueous hazardous waste. Organic solvents (waste tubes with hexanes and 2-propanol) – dispose as organic hazardous waste. All PCB-exposed disposable glassware, foil, GC vials, and gloves – dispose as PCB-contaminated hazardous waste. Serological pipettes – sharps container.
Let the silica gel precipitate to the bottom.

steps.title: Combust all glassware and tools
steps.instruction: Place silica gel, glass wool, all glassware (cartridges, short and long pipettes, tubes, beaker/volumetric flask, funnel), scalpel, forceps, and spatula in a furnace and combust according to safety guidelines.

steps.title: Label sample tubes
steps.instruction: Label tubes as Tube‑A1, A2…; Tube‑B1, B2…; Tube‑C1, C2…; Tube‑D1, D2… and a Reference tube.

steps.title: Thaw standards and internal standards
steps.instruction: Remove the Ongoing Recovery and Precision (ORP) standard (PCB18 and 4′‑OH‑PCB18) and the Surrogate Standard solutions (d‑PCB30 and 4‑OH‑PCB52) from the freezer and allow them to warm to room temperature for about 30 min. Also remove the Internal Standard (PCB204, 100 ng mL⁻¹) from the freezer and warm for ~30 min.

steps.title: Weigh tissue and prepare tube‑A
steps.instruction: Place ~100 mg of liver or brain tissue into a labeled Tube‑A, record the exact weight, and wash the scalpel, forceps and spatula between samples with water, acetone and hexanes.

steps.title: Add 2‑propanol and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of 2‑propanol to each Tube‑A with a repeater pipettor, then homogenize for 30–60 s. Rinse the TissueRuptor blade between samples with water in a beaker followed by ~5 mL 2‑propanol in a test tube.

steps.title: Add diethyl ether and vortex
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 1 mL diethyl ether to each Tube‑A, recap, and vortex gently.

steps.title: Spike surrogate standards
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of d‑PCB30 (100 ng mL⁻¹) and 100 µL of 4‑OH‑PCB52 (100 ng mL⁻¹) to every Tube‑A (method blanks, tissue blanks, tissues, ORP, and Reference). This provides 10 ng of each surrogate per tube.

steps.title: Spike ORP and reference standards
steps.instruction: To Tube‑A ORP samples and the Reference tube only, add 100 µL PCB18 standard (100 ng mL⁻¹) and 100 µL 4′‑OH‑PCB18 standard mixture (100 ng mL⁻¹), delivering 10 ng of each analyte.

steps.title: Invert tube‑A on rotator
steps.instruction: Place Tube‑A on a tube rotator and invert for 5 min at 40 RPM.

steps.title: Add phosphoric acid to tube‑B
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) in NaCl to a labeled Tube‑B using a repeater pipettor.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to tube‑B
steps.instruction: Using a long glass pipette, transfer the supernatant from Tube‑A to Tube‑B.

steps.title: Extract with 2‑propanol and hexanes‑ether
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 2‑propanol and 3 mL hexanes‑diethyl ether (9:1, v/v) to Tube‑A, vortex 10 s, centrifuge 5 min at 3000 rpm (~1811 g), then transfer the supernatant to Tube‑B.

steps.title: Collect organic layer in tube‑C
steps.instruction: Transfer the top organic layer from Tube‑B to a new Tube‑C with a long pipette.

steps.title: Re‑extract tube‑B and combine
steps.instruction: Re‑extract Tube‑B with 3 mL hexanes‑diethyl ether (9:1, v/v), vortex, centrifuge (5 min, 3000 rpm), then transfer this supernatant to Tube‑C, giving a combined volume of ~7 mL.

steps.title: Evaporate tube‑C to ~100 µL
steps.instruction: Evaporate the solvent in Tube‑C under a gentle stream of nitrogen (optionally using a 35 °C water bath) until ~100 µL remains.

steps.title: Add methanol drops
steps.instruction: Add 5 drops of methanol to Tube‑C (exclude the Reference tube), vortex 5 s, and place the tube in the fume hood.

steps.title: Derivatize with diazomethane
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, using a 10 mL serological pipette, add ~0.5 mL diazomethane (in diethyl ether) to each sample tube and 1 mL to the Reference tube.

steps.title: Label GC vials
steps.instruction: Label combusted crimp‑style GC vials with the corresponding sample numbers.

steps.title: Evaporate excess reagents
steps.instruction: Under a gentle nitrogen flow in the fume hood, evaporate excess ether and diazomethane until no yellow color remains (~200 µL). Evaporate the Reference tube to near dryness (~50 µL) and set aside for later internal‑standard spiking.

steps.title: Prepare SPE cartridges (dry loading)
steps.instruction: In each SPE cartridge place glass wool at the bottom, add 0.2 g silica gel, then 2 g acidified silica gel. Add the suspension of hexanes‑DCM (1:1, v/v) mixed with acidified silica gel (5:1) as described later, then rinse the packed cartridge with 3 mL hexanes‑DCM (1:1, v/v). Handle DCM in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 g silica gel with a combusted small glass funnel.
Add glass wool and pack down with the end of a glass pipette.
Replace the top and place the clean cartridge into a SPE port.
Mix 2 mL hexanes‑DCM (1:1) with acidified silica gel (5:1) in a small beaker, then add the suspension to the cartridge.
Rinse the cartridge with 2 mL hexanes‑DCM (1:1) using a long pipette.

steps.title: Set up SPE manifold
steps.instruction: Place uncombusted waste tubes at the bottom of the SPE manifold to collect waste eluent. Replace them with freshly labeled, combusted Tube‑D waste tubes, aligning Tube‑C in a rack with the corresponding Tube‑D positions.

steps.title: Load extracts onto SPE cartridge
steps.instruction: Using long glass pipettes, slowly load the combined extract from Tube‑C onto the SPE cartridge, allowing it to pass through. Then rinse Tube‑C twice with 0.5 mL hexanes‑DCM (1:1) and load this wash onto the cartridge.

steps.title: Elute SPE and collect in tube‑D
steps.instruction: Add additional hexanes‑DCM (1:1) to the cartridge until the eluent in Tube‑D reaches ~10 mL (total added ≈9 mL). Open the SPE valve completely to flush all residual solvent into Tube‑D, maintaining a controlled drop‑by‑drop flow and keeping the solvent level above the acidified silica gel.

steps.title: Turn off vacuum and remove tube‑D
steps.instruction: Turn off the manifold vacuum and remove Tube‑D from the SPE manifold.

steps.title: Concentrate and exchange solvent in tube‑D
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sample in Tube‑D under a gentle nitrogen stream to ~200 µL, then add 3 mL hexanes and reconcentrate to ~50 µL to exchange the solvent.

steps.title: Add internal standard
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of internal standard (PCB204, 100 ng mL⁻¹) to Tube‑D and to the Reference tube using a single‑channel pipette, then vortex Tube‑D.

steps.title: Transfer extracts to GC vials
steps.instruction: Using a long pipette, transfer the contents of Tube‑D and the Reference tube into combusted crimp‑style GC vials. Rinse Tube‑D with hexanes and combine the rinse with the vial to reach a final volume of ~0.6 mL.

steps.title: Prepare solvent blank
steps.instruction: Fill a GC vial with hexanes (the same hexanes used for extractions) to serve as a solvent blank.

steps.title: Store samples before analysis
steps.instruction: Store all GC vials, including the solvent blank, in a solvent‑proof –20 °C freezer (not a regular freezer) until instrumental analysis.

steps.title: Post‑analysis cleanup and recapping
steps.instruction: After instrument analysis, wash used glass cartridges with soapy water and a brush, dry, then combust in the furnace. Combust used needles. Recap all vials to minimize solvent loss; if needed, refill each vial to ~0.6 mL.

steps.title: Prepare for derivatization (diazomethane)
steps.instruction: Gather samples, an ice box, and serological pipettes in a fume hood. Remove the diazomethane solution (in diethyl ether) from the freezer and place it in the ice box. Cap all tubes and store them in an explosion‑proof refrigerator at 4–8 °C for at least 3 h or overnight (~16 h). Mix each suspension with a short glass pipette tip to eliminate air bubbles.
